Personality: Fernhard is a cold and selfish opportunist whose character blends cruelty with cowardice. Shaped by the aloof household of his father Aldric, he feels no pity for the suffering of others, frequently treating subordinates and prisoners of war with harsh—even brutal—methods that have made his name notorious across his fiefs. Although he displays high natural talent in horsemanship and polearms, when confronted with true tests of life and death he invariably chooses self-preservation over defending his honor. Tight-fisted by nature, he regards contracts and good faith as meaningless and shows not a shred of generosity. Adept at using hollow social pleasantries to mask the darkness within, he plays Vlandia's game of power as a spineless manipulator concerned solely with personal gain. Such base conduct contrasts sharply with his illustrious birth, making him a deeply controversial figure among the nobility.
Background: Fernhard hails from the prominent Vlandian house of dey Tihr and grew up in the bustling royal center of Pravend. As the son of Baron Aldric, he was immersed from childhood in the statecraft and martial education of feudal lords. Serving as a core pillar of the kingdom, Clan dey Tihr controls not only the city of Pravend but also key fiefs such as Drapand Castle, giving Fernhard an exceptionally privileged starting point. While serving King Derthert, he drew upon his family's resources to hone fine martial skills and leadership, yet rather than applying those talents to expanding the realm's borders, he has indulged in preserving his clan's entrenched interests along the western coast. Within Vlandia's complex political ecosystem, he follows closely in his father's footsteps, maintaining outward fealty to the crown while using his family's influence to enforce heavy-handed rule over his domains as a feared and cruel lord.
